title: 第3章 妖孽天赋开心眼第4章 观棋下山遇故人
content_zh:
;;
一处风景秀丽的高山之上，有一个不为人知的村庄。
福隆村。
村子里有接近三百户人家。
夜幕降临时，家家户户炊烟袅袅。
身穿花袄的妇人打开院门扯起嗓子呼喊着各家孩子的名字。
“铁蛋！”
“狗蛋！！回家吃饭了！”
“翠花~回来了啊。”
“辰辰，死孩子还不快点回来！”
一位个子比较高的男孩狠狠的将手中男孩丢下。
口中骂道：“死瞎子，再让我看到你下次还揍你！”
躺在地上的少年嘴角露出一丝莫名的笑意，口中轻声道：“赵北辰，你等着。”
少年约莫十三四岁，面如刀削，鼻梁高挺，嘴唇微薄。
穿着一身灰色麻衣，双眼处却蒙着一条白色的丝绸带。
话音刚落！
赵北辰双眼露出狠色，抬手便要对着少年落下拳头。
却被身旁的孩子给拦了下来，小男孩苦着脸说道：“北辰，抓紧回去吧，我娘都喊我吃饭了。”
等几个孩子走后，躺在地上的少年一个鲤鱼打挺就起来了。
擦了擦嘴角的血迹，背着手吊儿郎当的往家里走去。

一边走，少年一边耸动着鼻子，好似刚刚挨打的根本不是自己一般。
寻着香味，少年趴在一户人家的篱笆墙上喊道：“李婶儿~今儿这是什么日子啊？还炖了小母鸡？”
吱嘎~
一位略显发福的中年妇人推门而出，满脸笑意的看向少年招呼道。
“是观棋啊，吃没吃呢？婶子给你拿点。”
李观棋装模作样的摸了摸肚子说道：“还真没吃呢。”
“这不是狗鼻子灵么，不想吃我爷爷弄得糠咽菜，这不寻着味就来了么。”
妇人见状连忙摆了摆手说道：“臭小子可别乱说话，正好，婶子这还剩了半盆。”
“我再给你打点米饭，你端回去和你爷爷一起吃。”
少年听闻此话顿时脸上笑意更甚了几分，嘴甜的说道：“谢谢李婶儿。”
“哎…李婶儿这手艺不去下山开饭馆真是可惜了。”
妇人的眼睛弯了弯，眼角的皱纹都多了几丝。
“臭小子，就属你嘴甜，等着。”
没过一会，一个犹如瓷娃娃般的小丫头就端着一盆香喷喷的炖鸡走了出来。
小丫头端着满满一盆的炖鸡，怕洒了，一双眼睛盯着菜盆瞪的滴溜圆。
一边走小丫头还一边嘟囔道：“李观棋你是属狗么？每次我家做好吃的你都准时准点来。”
李观棋趴在篱笆墙上忍不住说道：“孟婉舒，你说谁以后能娶了你这个贤妻良母呢？”
孟婉舒小脸一红，费了好大力气才把那盆菜端上篱笆墙。
对着李观棋翻了个白眼就往屋里跑，可紧接着她便想到李观棋看不到。
content_en:
;;
There is an unknown village on a high mountain with beautiful scenery.
Fulong Village.
There are nearly three hundred households in the village.
As night falls, smoke curls from every household.
A woman in a flowered coat opened the courtyard door and shouted the names of the children from each family at the top of her voice.
"Iron egg!"
"Goudan!! Let's go home for dinner!"
"Cuihua~ is back."
"Chenchen, why don't you come back soon, this damn kid!"
A taller boy dropped the boy in his hands harshly.
He cursed in his mouth: "You blind man, if you let me see you again, I will beat you next time!"
The young man lying on the ground had an inexplicable smile on his face, and said softly: "Zhao Beichen, just wait."
The boy was about thirteen or fourteen years old, with a sharp face, a high nose, and thin lips.
Wearing gray linen clothes, his eyes were covered with a white silk belt.
The words just fell!
Zhao Beichen's eyes showed a ruthless look, and he raised his hand to punch the young man.
But he was stopped by the child next to him. The little boy said with a grimace: "Beichen, hurry up and go back. My mother has already called me to eat."
After the children left, the boy lying on the ground stood up in a jiffy.
Wiping the blood from the corner of his mouth, he walked home with his hands hanging on his back.
As he walked, the boy twitched his nose, as if the one who had just been beaten was not him at all.
Looking for the scent, the young man leaned on the fence of a house and shouted: "Aunt Li~ What kind of day is it today? Did you stew a little hen?"
Zhiqua~
A slightly stout middle-aged woman pushed open the door and greeted the young man with a smile on her face.
"We're watching chess. Have you eaten? Auntie will get you some."
Li Guanqi pretended to touch his stomach and said, "I really haven't eaten yet."
"Isn't this a dog with a sharp nose? He doesn't want to eat the chaffy vegetables my grandpa made, so he comes here without looking for the taste."
Seeing this, the woman quickly waved her hand and said, "You bastard, don't talk nonsense. Just in time, Auntie still has half the pot left."
"I'll get you some more rice, and you can take it back and eat it with your grandpa."
When the young man heard this, the smile on his face became even bigger, and he said sweetly: "Thank you, Aunt Li."
"Hey...it would be a pity if Aunt Li doesn't go down the mountain to open a restaurant with her skills."
The woman's eyes were curved, and there were a few more wrinkles at the corners of her eyes.
"You brat, it's your sweet mouth, just wait."
After a while, a little girl who looked like a porcelain doll came out carrying a pot of fragrant chicken stew.
The little girl was carrying a pot full of stewed chicken, and stared at the pot with wide eyes for fear of spilling it.
As she walked, the little girl muttered: "Li Guanqi, are you a dog? Every time my family makes delicious food, you come on time."
Li Guanqi lay on the fence and couldn't help but said: "Meng Wanshu, who do you think can marry a good wife and mother like you in the future?"
Meng Wanshu blushed, and it took a lot of effort to carry the pot of vegetables up the fence.
She rolled her eyes at Li Guanqi and ran into the house, but then she thought that Li Guanqi couldn't see her.
